name: utf-store
description: Monorepo do UTF Store (frontend Vue + backend NestJS + código compartilhado)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,front -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:front"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:front
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @utf-store/shared --if-present && npm run lint -w app-api && npm run lint -w app-front
scripts.lint:check: npm exec -w app-api -- eslint "{src,apps,libs,test}/**/*.ts" && npm run lint -w app-front
scripts.check: npm run lint:check && npm run typecheck
scripts.format: npm run format -w app-api && npm run format -w app-front
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @utf-store/shared && npm run typecheck -w app-api && npm run build -w app-front
scripts.prisma:migrate: npm exec -w app-api -- prisma migrate dev
